calculate_retrieval_recall: calculate retrieval recall at top-k for image retrieval predictions against ground truth labels
calculate_retrieval_average_precision: calculate average precision for image retrieval using IR or integrate mode
use_retrieval_recall_metric: use RetrievalRecall metric class with Evaluator to compute Recall@1 and Recall@5 scores
use_retrieval_average_precision_metric: use RetrievalAveragePrecision metric class with Evaluator to compute mAP scores for retrieval
format_prediction_indices: format prediction labels to top-k indices using _format_pred helper function
